mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 5.0% triggers a hawkish monetary policy shift, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment growth (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1600 thousand units and quarterly GDP growth exceeds 1.0% year-over-year, the economy enters a strong expansion phase that boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where HOUST > 1600 and GDPC1 QoQ > 1.0%, the S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 100.0 (indicating manufacturing expansion) reduces supply shock risks and supports corporate profit growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales growth rate exceeding 0.8% signals robust consumer spending, which increases corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS MoM exceeds 0.8%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals a tightening labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE declines by more than 0.3pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) signals a successful monetary policy tightening that stabilizes the economy without causing a recession, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL falling fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
